decisions: Use existing reconstructed bodies and actual director slot words / outgoing message arguments; no new native-address body or ledger row was needed.
Count projects only the command_class words its body reads; it does not classify unrelated targets or paths.
The clear-command result supplies the serialized type, arm byte and index DWORD. The transport still supplies the recovered base/header stores, and memcpy preserves the -1 index bit pattern.
Existing host paths remain unchanged in the switch's else arms and do not execute on the enabled path.
The 5Fh remove-point receiver alone would have no live producer, so no dead-path wiring or new user input binding was added.

rows.reason: The existing live 5Fh sender always sets presence to one; a remove-point message producer is missing, so adding only its absent-payload receive arm would not execute.
The retained path object exists, but no live sender requests removal of its last point; 0071F5D0 would need that producer first.
The route host exposes the add-point callback only; the original follower listener slot-7 remove-point operation has no bound invoking caller.
The host mutates its local path cursor directly and lacks the listener-owned 60h message producer and receiver needed to replace that transition.
A native listener's offset-enable byte +18h and vector +20h have no retained producer; passing an invented disabled offset would only wrap the existing point copy.
The real sender uses 0071D340 MOVSS copies; this value constructor's FLD/FSTP copies would change signaling-NaN and FP-status behavior.
No polymorphic type-query dispatch is needed on this dedicated 5Fh channel; the predicate ignores its receiver and querying constant 5Fh would add a constant-true guard.
The dedicated 5Dh queue lacks a polymorphic type-query consumer; querying the known constructor's constant class would add a constant-true guard.
The dedicated 5Ah queue lacks a polymorphic type-query consumer; the predicate ignores mutable object state and a constant class query would not replace gameplay work.
No retained ControllerStateMessage producer, snapshot transport or snapshot consumer exists at the host's flattened flag reads.
The score-list's only native reader is the debug overlay; the host has no gameplay list consumer, and debug-only work is excluded.
The score-list storage and gameplay consumer are absent; its native debug-only overlay reader is excluded.
The HUD ambient-sound instance publication is missing; the binding currently records and discards the volume rather than owning a SoundInstance.
The host returns no weapon-animation handle or object, so the timer/range fields and consuming animation are missing.
The screen's native selection vector, +C0h/+D4h fields and two input-context levels are not retained by these selection tails.
The host has no BriefingScreenState object and consumer for this reconstructed title/side-block assignment.
The language catalog is bound, but the collection consumer is gated by an unhosted profile-hints mode-2 state and cannot run on the current path.
